In an extensive recent interview on Clique TV, Apple CEO John Ternus answered questions on a wide range of topics, including his vision for the future, how his family uses technology, the story behind being tapped to become CEO, and his thoughts on Vision Pro.

New CEO Takes the Helm: John Ternus's Long-Form Interview Covers a Range of Topics

Mouloud Achour of Clique TV sat down with Apple's new CEO John Ternus earlier this month, and the interview segments were released over the weekend.

Ternus discussed several topics in the interview, including how to make a compelling case for Apple Vision Pro. As one of his first major interviews since taking over as CEO, he was naturally asked about the transition process.

On Being Asked to Become Apple's New CEO

Ternus was also asked about the important lessons he learned from his two predecessors — Tim Cook and Steve Jobs. When asked to share specific quotes from those former Apple leaders that had inspired him, Ternus gave a slightly different answer.

On Apple's Future Vision, Including AI

On the Role of Technology in Children's Upbringing
